findings.summary: Modified Time value read from the wrong column: validity check uses index 9 (Last Modified) but data read uses index 8 (Icon), which is the pre-Tags column number that was not updated
findings.failure_scenario: User imports a CSV with a Last Modified column mapped. The entry's modification time is parsed from the value in the Icon column (e.g., an integer 0-99 becomes a 1970 timestamp) instead of the actual timestamp column.

findings.summary: Created Time value read from the wrong column: validity check uses index 10 (Created) but data read uses index 9 (Last Modified), which was not updated after the Tags column insertion
findings.failure_scenario: User imports a CSV with a Created column mapped. The entry's creation time is parsed from the Last Modified column instead. The Created column value is silently ignored.

findings.summary: Error message truncation label shows wrong skip count: appendStatusMsg no longer appends a trailing newline per message, so text.count('\n') returns one less than the number of messages, causing 'N more message(s) skipped' to display N-1
findings.failure_scenario: CSV file has 4 malformed records producing 4 error messages. Two are displayed with the label '[1 more message(s) skipped]' but actually 2 are skipped. The singular/plural form is also wrong.

findings.summary: testEmptyReparsing test removed, silently dropping coverage for the parse(nullptr) followed by reparse() code path
findings.failure_scenario: A future refactoring that breaks the reparse-after-null behavior would not be caught by the test suite. The behavior is preserved currently but unguarded.
